verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs show automatic preview environments on every Git push, with a preview URL for every branch. They also show preview-specific environment variables and access controls, so the core preview-deployment workflow is clearly documented. The docs tie previews to pushes and branches rather than pull requests, never call them ephemeral, and never show a full-stack preview (for example, a per-preview database). Neon branching is only a marketplace integration and is not linked to previews. Missing for 10: explicit per-pull-request preview creation, documented ephemeral lifecycle/teardown, full-stack (backend/database) per-preview provisioning, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get ephemeral full-stack preview environments for every pull request

citations.quote: Connect your Git repository to deploy on every push, with automatic preview environments for testing changes before production.
